title: Grateful Dead Live at West High Auditorium  on 1980-06-19
lineage: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition 2.0> (dither/downsample)> FLAC
source: 2 Nak 700s with bass eq mounted on pole> Sony TC-D5 (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs + 1 Maxell UD XL-I)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑recorded show shines with a stellar Peggy‑O and crisp China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, but heavy Dolby processing dulls some highs.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as one of the band’s great shows – highlighted by an unforgettable Peggy‑O, a tight China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider sequence and solid Sailor/​Saint. The audience recording is generally clear and beats many soundboard sources, though reviewers note that excessive Dolby compression squashes the high frequencies.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several standout songs outweighs moderate recording issues (Dolby compression); three reviews provide a balanced view.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and well‑balanced overall, better than many SBD mixes; however heavy Dolby processing mutes highs and gives a slightly squashed sound.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong setlist with a particularly compelling second‑set pre‑drums segment; the show maintains high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Drums: Interesting drum performance noted, which is rare for this reviewer.
